note: Election of councillors for the four wards and of the four aldermen of Newtownards Borough Council, polled 21 May 1952. Labour gained two seats from the Unionists. Three Unionist aldermen were returned unopposed (J. M. Poots, S. J. McWatters, H. M. Donaldson; Irish News, 22 May 1952) without their wards being printed: McWatters is filed under Victoria Ward from the 1946 return; Poots and Donaldson held no aldermanship in 1946, so their wards (Castle and Glen) cannot be fixed and those two aldermanships are not recorded. The Scrabo Ward aldermanship is not recorded either: the News-Letter prints Isaac Baxter (Ind.) 885 with no opponent, the Irish News J. Baxter (Ind.) 835 against R. B. McGimpsey 312, and no majority, total or turnout is printed to settle the figure. Returned unopposed. Division inferred from the 1946 return (Belfast News-Letter, 5 September 1946, p. 3: Victoria Ward aldermanship, S. J. M'Watters); the Irish News, 22 May 1952, p. 7, names the member as returned but not his ward. Returned unopposed.
